control_note: Planted edge: at the first RTH bar of each session, the control knows the sign of that session's last-RTH-close minus first-RTH-open (unadjusted). It holds that direction until RTH close (session flatten, C10). Brackets are 1:1 20000/20000 ticks (CME 20% limit-move ceiling; not an 8-tick clip) so a shuffled 50% null is not a 2R artefact. time_stop_bars=2000 cannot fire inside one RTH session. Four-leg costs unchanged. Known size is the session RTH open-to-close move minus costs. | MES: planted detected, null rejected; MNQ: planted detected, null rejected
